summary: Become methods can't be chained; you can't use sudo /bin/su -, you need direct sudo or su rights to the target user.
questions: Can I use sudo su - as my become method?
Can I chain sudo and su in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Only one become method per host
answer_card.answer_md: Methods can't be chained. You can't do `sudo /bin/su -`; you need permission to run as the target user directly with sudo, or to `su` to it directly (same for pbrun, pfexec, etc.).
